fields.fromStage: stage id, or null when the request is opened
fields.humanDecision: null, or { gate, decision, decidedBy, at } copied from the owning bot's stage-return

postedTo: The request thread in Lead's chat (thread.channel lead-chat)

state.sourceOfTruth: Lead memory pid.state.{requestId} holds pid, version, current stage, status, and the thread pointer
state.thread: One thread per request, opened in Lead's chat. Human gates are asked by the stage owner in that bot's own chat. The owner returns the verbatim reply to Lead.
state.audit: Every bot copies Release Desk Log (priority false) on each message sent or received, each REJECT, and each gate ask/decision; Lead also copies each stage transition. The Log never routes or approves.
state.otherBots: Specialists store their own slice (estimate, findings, build record) and return it by teammate message. They do not advance pid.state.
